highlight.none: The skeletons show only while the tree loads, which is over before a ring could be drawn; step 3 rings what replaces them.

steps.note: Kit Marlow is signed in on a fresh Endgame. Home asks for the tree; while it loads, grey placeholders stand in.
A real, empty answer: no organisation anywhere yet, and firstRun says this person may name the first one.

highlight.text: Name your organisation, then describe your first idea.
highlight.note: The first-run band: what to do, one line on what happens next, and Start.
The header holds only the Endgame mark: no breadcrumb, bell or credits until an organisation exists.

highlight.text: What do you want to build?
highlight.note: Start opens the start screen, where the organisation is named with its first idea.

variations.title: A FrostAura operator with no organisation sees God mode instead

highlight.text: You run Endgame for FrostAura. Every organisation is one step away.
highlight.note: An operator is never offered a first organisation: home is the God-mode panel (ORG-17).
